title: Secret versioning and access audit
intent: Model secret rotation and access explicitly while keeping plaintext out of persistence, logs, read models, and status/result payloads.
observed_behavior: service_secrets stored only the current encrypted payload and integer version.
secret resolution returned plaintext without a versioned audit manifest or access audit row.
intended_behavior: Each service secret has immutable encrypted version rows in secret_versions.
Existing service_secrets rows are backfilled as version 1 during migration.
Each resolve and runtime apply attempt writes secret_access_audit metadata without plaintext.
Resolvers can return a safe SecretAccessManifest alongside resolved plaintext values.
